$comment: Component registry. `dependencies` lists sibling registry files copied along with the component. `requires` lists peers every component needs, because each one imports from 'ferrule', which imports Reanimated.

stack.description: Stack, Spacer and Divider layout primitives.

spinner.description: Drawn loading ring, identical on every platform.

button.description: Solid, outline, ghost and danger buttons with loading state.

input.description: Labelled text field with helper and error messages.

card.description: Surface with header, content and footer. Optionally pressable.

checkbox.description: Checkbox with indeterminate and error states.

avatar.description: User image with initials and placeholder fallbacks.

image.description: Image with loading state, alt text and failure fallback.

list.description: Virtualized list with empty and loading states, plus ListItem.

modal.description: Centered dialog with scrolling content and footer.

sheet.description: Bottom sheet with swipe to dismiss.

toast.description: Transient notifications that stack above overlays.

icon.description: Tinted Feather icon, or your own single-color artwork.

chip.description: Compact filter or action, with an optional native variant.

segmented.description: One choice out of a few, with an optional native variant.

tabbar.description: Bottom navigation, with an optional native variant.

progress.description: Linear and circular progress, driven by Reanimated.

swipe-row.description: A row with swipe actions, also offered to screen readers.

carousel.description: A sideways row of same-width items.
